claims.scope: Bidirectional RNA language-model family pretrained at single-nucleotide resolution, with 1,024- and 10,240-nucleotide contexts. The paper evaluates transferable representations, transcript-property prediction, mutation scoring, and a separate conditioned mRNA-generation framework.

claims.input_output: RNA sequence -> nucleotide probabilities and embeddings; downstream biological predictions

claims.input_output: SMILES/featurized molecular graph -> 720-dimensional embedding; embeddings plus labelled examples -> downstream predictions through a separate predictor
